rejected_sources.reason: Search results for savings rates returned NerdWallet, Forbes Advisor, Business Insider, GOBankingRates and similar pages. None of their numbers are used, because the requirement is an official first-party source. They were consulted only to discover official URLs (for example the citi.com savings page path).

These banks publish comparison tables quoting competitors' rates (for example 'Chase 0.02%'). Those figures are marketing quotes about other banks, not those banks' own publications, so they are excluded.
